title: Born at Deer Range plantation below New Orleans
summary: Brown says he was born at Deer Range, down the river, home of Jim Robinson, a few miles from Magnolia where many musicians came from.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Oh, I born in a little country place by the name of Deerange. That was down on the other side of the river? Yeah. That's where Jim Robinson... That's where Jim Robinson from.
That was near Magnolia Plantation, was it? Well, it's a few miles from Magnolia. Uh, you know, there's a lot of musicians came from there, like Sonny Henry and the others that we know of.
Well, all the fellas just about from down that way, further down and coming up about three, four miles apart, you know?
And was Magnolia farther down the river? Yeah. It was farther down.
